_what: Counted debts and armed-obligation floors. A ratchet is equality in BOTH directions (C-0005): the check fails when the number rises AND when it falls below the record, so every payoff and every regression is a visible diff line in the same change that causes it. Never widen a ratchet to silence a red; fix the cause or record the movement deliberately.
